viewing_check: Look for maker marks: underside of body, rear panel, hubcaps, steering wheel centre, pedal crank and stamped part numbers (Murray, Cyclops, Hamilton, Steelcraft). Photograph the bonnet number ('...7 A') and the 'M / NC 554' stencil. Check completeness (windscreen, tow handle, pedals, both bumpers), rust-through, and whether the paint and decals are original.
